svg.title: The Egres fiber scheduler: one process, eight threads, one capped tenant and thousands of others
svg.desc: Eight thread lanes of cpu ticks. Tenant A burns its cpu allowance over three ticks and is parked for the next three while every other tenant keeps running. Below, a grid of 320 tenants on this process, each running, waiting for iops, or parked at a resource cap.
